component.name: Aster
component.summary: Watch and listen from Jellyfin, Emby and Plex

description.p: Aster is a media player for your own Jellyfin, Emby or Plex server, made for the couch: a game controller or a remote works everywhere, and it runs full screen from Steam.

ul.li: Films, shows, anime, music, audiobooks and Live TV
DVD and Blu-ray style disc menus, from the Aster Disc plugin
TV-style channels made from your playlists
Anime openings and endings, with their songs named
Surround sound passed through to a receiver, and Sonos for music
